_comment: Krea 2 Turbo (OSS_TURBO) single-stream MMDiT for the pure-Swift krea2-image-director. 28 blocks x 6144 dim, GQA 48/12 heads, Qwen3-VL text path, qwen_image_vae. Weights externalized to the content-addressed store; this in-tree entry is a symlink. Q8 (8-bit g64) produced by scripts/krea2_quantize_turbo.py from bf16 turbo.safetensors.
name: krea2-turbo
description: Krea 2 Turbo DiT, 8-bit MLX (group_size=64). CFG-free, 8 steps, mu=1.15. Native Swift port in swift/krea2-image-director.
author_notes: Quantized 2026-07-03 from bf16 turbo.safetensors (24GB) -> 13.65GB (52%). Native Swift t2i+i2i verified; VLM 8/10 vs 9.2 bf16 (within variance). lin() auto-detects quantized weights via the .scales companion key. bf16 original lives in _staging_krea2/ (not in store).
